verdict.rationale: The docs say events can be captured "from any SDK", and the AI wizard instruments "the PostHog SDKs client-side and server-side" across 26+ documented frameworks and languages. A plain HTTP capture API covers any other language, and a hands-on user called integration with a Swift iOS app "pretty straightforward". Missing for 10: an enumerated list of official SDKs per platform (web/JS, Android, React Native/Flutter, specific backend languages) and SDK-specific docs or independent corroboration beyond iOS.
